evals.name: exit-animation-in-react
evals.query: The mobile nav panel disappears instantly when closed. Make it slide out smoothly.
expected_behavior: Reads references/css-or-motion.md and notes that exit animations need Motion AnimatePresence because React removes the element at once.
Checks package.json, sees motion is not installed, and asks before adding it (or offers a CSS-only alternative such as keeping the element mounted).
Uses motion/react in a 'use client' leaf only, never framer-motion.
Uses token durations and honors reduced motion.

evals.name: css-spring-generation
evals.query: Give me a gentle CSS spring for the event card hover lift.
expected_behavior: Calls mcp__motion__generate-css-easing with kind spring, a short duration and a low bounce.
Uses the returned duration and linear() easing in a transition on transform only.
If the motion MCP server is unavailable, says so and uses a cubic-bezier from references/css-spring.md instead of inventing linear() values.

evals.name: gated-motion-plus-example
evals.query: Add a Motion ticker of sponsor logos to the homepage.
expected_behavior: Recognizes Ticker as a paid motion-plus component and does not import or install motion-plus.
Links the public demo if search returns a gated item and does not reconstruct its source.
Offers a free CSS or motion-based alternative and leaves the choice to the user.

evals.name: should-not-trigger-motion-language
evals.query: What should our standard durations and easing be across the site, and should anything bounce?
expected_behavior: Does not load motion; this is the project's motion language (motion-system-orchestration).
Presents options with a recommendation instead of deciding.
